title: GreyZone: Production-quality Agentic Application Threats
abstract: arXiv:2611.09161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents are increasingly deployed across domains such as coding, banking, and commerce. Their ability to invoke tools and change application state makes security testing important for reliable deployment. Although agent security has been studied through various adversarial testing approaches, benchmarks grounded in production agent environments remain limited. We introduce GreyZone, a benchmark for evaluating automated red-teaming services against real-world agent applications. Unlike benchmarks such as AgentDojo, which primarily evaluate subject agents under attack, GreyZone evaluates services' ability to generate and deliver attacks that cause verified security-policy violations. We select independently developed, open-source agent applications with security boundaries concerning access permissions, confidentiality, and action authorization. translated_title: GreyZone：生产级智能体应用威胁
translated_abstract: 智能体正日益被部署在编程、银行和商业等领域。它们调用工具和改变应用状态的能力使得安全测试对于可靠部署至关重要。尽管智能体安全已经通过各种对抗性测试方法得到了研究，但基于生产环境智能体应用的基准测试仍然有限。我们提出了GreyZone，一个用于评估自动化红队服务对抗真实世界智能体应用能力的基准。与主要评估受攻击的主体智能体的AgentDojo等基准不同，GreyZone评估的是服务生成并发起攻击、造成可验证的安全策略违规的能力。我们选择了独立开发的开源智能体应用，这些应用涉及访问权限、机密性和操作授权等安全边界。这些应用暴露出多样化的攻击面，包括源自多智能体交互（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了GreyZone基准，用于评估自动化红队服务能否对真实生产环境中的开源智能体应用生成攻击，并造成可验证的安全策略违规。
en_tdlr: GreyZone is a benchmark for evaluating automated red-teaming services' ability to generate and deliver attacks that cause verified security-policy violations in real-world production agent applications.
